sources.title: Meet Spirit Fox!
facts: Spirit Walk turns both Fox and paired Hero invisible; Spirit Fox targets ground, favors targets within 4.5 tiles of its Hero and has movement speed 24.
The primary level table gives invisibility durations of 3 seconds at L1-4, 3.5 seconds at L5-9 and 4 seconds at L10, with L1-10 HP and DPS.
sources.limitations: Launch values do not establish the 2026 client build, initial trigger phase, visibility effects on existing targets, target selection tie-break or exact recast tick.

sources.title: February 2024 Update - Patch Notes

sources.limitations: No current projectile, impact, retarget or paired-Hero contract is supplied.

sources.title: New Balance Changes Incoming!

sources.limitations: The publication does not identify the first visible interval, trigger phase, inclusive expiration tick, or later superseding patches.
